blacklistabilityReview.evidence: XUSD is directly blacklistable on both material deployments. BSC holds 73.67% of circulating supply (2026-10-19 census) at token 0xf81ac2e1a0373dde1bce01e2fe694a9b7e3bfcb9; at BSC block 128504445 the token's blacklister() was 0x21c6a28dCc3192c81E30a3b03D38b4c517F87ee9 (non-zero), owner() was 0x7942337923d89D27e801B6DC05274fA9417968F5, masterMinter() was 0x31b964870f90d25837afC995239273F72931e7A3, and paused() was false. Ethereum holds 26.33% at token 0xc08e7e23c235073c6807c2efe7021304cb7c2815; at Ethereum block 26224762 the blacklister() was 0x7081b2058A879eEcF90F025cFC4dE1B828178CA4 (non-zero), owner() was 0x9bd41d6CAA1Ad2bE20Ea48C5f4Be3C180522F964, masterMinter() was 0x53Cb1e2579DA18e6132dCfb00FD75A0BE0F7C5AB, paused() was false, and isBlacklisted(owner) returned false. The Circle-style FiatToken surface exposes blacklist/unBlacklist to the assigned blacklister, so the issuer can deny named holders transfers and receipts. The Solana deployment (SPL mint/freeze authority a 3-of-11 multisig) carries a negligible census share and is disclosed but does not set the verdict. No parent or reserve test is needed: a direct holder-targeted control is active on both material deployments.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: XUSD is issuer-minted natively by StraitsX on all three tracked networks: Ethereum and BNB Chain use the Circle-style MasterMinter pattern with chain-local 3-of-5 owner and master-minter Safes, and the Solana mint/freeze authority is a 3-of-11 SPL multisig. Separate legacy proxy admins can replace the Ethereum and BNB Chain token implementations. No third-party bridge carries the XUSD claim; cross-chain movement is issuer-native burn/mint through StraitsX rails.
